title: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach
author: Russell & Norvig
description: A comprehensive survey of AI, from search and logic through machine learning.

title: Atomic Habits
author: James Clear
description: A practical framework for building good habits and breaking bad ones.

title: Clean Code
author: Robert C. Martin
description: Practical guidance on writing maintainable code, with before-and-after refactoring examples.

title: Computer Networks
author: Andrew S. Tanenbaum
description: A layer-by-layer treatment of network architecture, from the physical layer up through applications.

title: Data Structures and Algorithms in Java
author: Robert Lafore
description: Core data structures — trees, graphs, hash tables — built up from first principles with working Java code.

title: Database System Concepts
author: Silberschatz, Korth & Sudarshan
description: The relational model, SQL, normalization, transaction processing, and query optimization.

title: Design Patterns
author: Gamma, Helm, Johnson & Vlissides
description: The classic catalog of object-oriented design patterns, from the Gang of Four.

title: Introduction to Algorithms
author: Cormen, Leiserson, Rivest & Stein
description: The standard reference on algorithm design and analysis — sorting, graph algorithms, dynamic programming, and NP-completeness, with rigorous proofs throughout.

title: Operating System Concepts
author: Silberschatz, Galvin & Gagne
description: Process management, memory management, file systems, and concurrency — the core operating systems course text.

title: Project Hail Mary
author: Andy Weir
description: A lone astronaut wakes with no memory of his mission — or that humanity's survival depends on it.

title: Sapiens
author: Yuval Noah Harari
description: A sweeping account of how Homo sapiens came to dominate the planet.

title: The Midnight Library
author: Matt Haig
description: A novel about all the lives you could have lived, told through a library between life and death.
